_comment: User-turn contexts for the colour-leakage probe. Each user_content ends IMMEDIATELY before a colour word (no trailing space), so the measured next token at position -1 is ' <colour>'. Mix of choice-framings (paint/logo/car/...) and identity-framings (favourite colour). The probe reads P(each colour) here; there is NO colour mentioned in the context itself, so any elevation of a colour must come from base rate or (when primed) from the assistant's stated favourite bleeding onto the user turn.
sentinel_note: Contexts intentionally contain no ' it came up' sentinel; the colour runner truncates the rendered chat template at the end of user_content, not at a fixed sentinel.
